question: The disinvestment of a public sector unit leads to _______.

options.text: reduction in financial assets of the government
increase in the financial assets of the government
creation of liability of the government
increase in the tax revenue of the government

solution:
The correct answer is __**reduction in financial assets of the government**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Disinvestment** refers to the process where the government sells its stake in public sector undertakings (PSUs) to private entities, either fully or partially.
 
• This sale of stakes results in a **reduction in the financial assets** of the government because the ownership (and associated value) of the assets is transferred to private investors.
 
• The objective of disinvestment is often to **raise funds** for the government, which can be utilized for developmental projects, reducing fiscal deficit, or other economic priorities.
 
• While the government earns revenue from the sale, the disinvestment process is classified as a reduction in financial assets since it involves the transfer of asset ownership from the public to the private sector.
 
• Disinvestment also aims to improve the operational efficiency of the PS
